senses.sense_definition: Geneigd om snel en overdreven zielig te doen of te klagen.

examples.text: Het is erg <w>jankerig</w> gedrag om bij elk klein probleem direct te gaan zeuren.

target_lang_translations.en: It is very <w>whiny</w> behavior to start complaining immediately at every small problem.

examples.text: Stop met dat <w>jankerige</w> gedoe en probeer het probleem zelf op te lossen.

target_lang_translations.en: Stop with that <w>whiny</w> nonsense and try to solve the problem yourself.

traits.comment: Wordt vaak gebruikt in informele contexten om kritiek te uiten.

target_lang_definitions.en: Inclined to complain or act pitiful in an exaggerated or annoying way.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Describing someone who complains in a high-pitched or annoying manner.
Describing someone who acts in a weak, pitiful, or overly complaining way.
General term for someone who expresses dissatisfaction frequently.
